name: build_inventory_grounded_record_collection
description: Resolve selected cultural anchors in Qloo, score only a merchant's stocked artists, enforce stock and merchandising constraints, and return an auditable collection. Requires a Side B owner session. Does not publish or reserve automatically.
authentication: Same-origin merchant session (HttpOnly guest cookie or Sites-authenticated account); include exact Origin header. Obtain canonical entities with GET /api/search first. Never send API credentials from a browser.
follow_up_tools: POST /api/campaigns with an owner-approved runId to publish
POST /api/campaigns/{id}/reserve for an explicit customer pickup hold
